outputs.outputText:
**Recommended semver bump:** **major** – breaking change: configuration file renamed to `forge.config.json`.

**Release announcement**  
We’re excited to ship version X.Y.Z with a major update that changes how the app is configured – the old `config.json` is no longer read; use `forge.config.json` instead. Dark mode is now fully supported with a toggle in Settings and no flicker on load. Exporting reports as PDF is available for the first time. The dashboard loads up to 40 % faster thanks to lazy‑loaded chunks. Minor bug fixes and documentation updates round out the release.

---  

## Changelog  

### Breaking Changes  
- **feat!** rename config file to `forge.config.json` (old `config.json` no longer read)

### Features  
- add dark mode toggle to settings  
- export report as PDF  

### Fixes  
- crash when uploading empty CSV resolved  
- dark mode flicker on load fixed  
- typo in footer corrected  

### Performance  
- dashboard loads 40 % faster via lazy chunks  

### Documentation  
- update README install steps  

### Chores  
- bump lodash to latest version  

---

**Recommended bump: MAJOR** — the config file rename (`config.json` → `forge.config.json`) is a breaking change: existing installs will silently lose their configuration unless users migrate.

---

## Release Announcement

⚠️ **Action required before upgrading:** the configuration file is now `forge.config.json`, and the old `config.json` is no longer read — rename your existing file to keep your settings. On the brighter side, this release adds a dark mode toggle in Settings (with the load-time flicker fixed). You can also export any report as a PDF with one click. The dashboard now loads 40% faster thanks to lazy-loaded chunks. Finally, uploading an empty CSV no longer crashes the app.

---

## Full Changelog

### ⚠️ Breaking Changes
- The config file has been renamed to `forge.config.json` — the old `config.json` is no longer read. Rename your existing config file when upgrading.

### ✨ Added
- Dark mode toggle in Settings
- Export reports as PDF

### 🚀 Performance
- Dashboard loads 40% faster via lazy-loaded chunks

### 🐛 Fixed
- Crash when uploading an empty CSV file
- Dark mode flicker on app load
- Typo in footer

### 📚 Docs & Maintenance
- Updated README installation steps
- Bumped lodash dependency
